Neither file is cited by any record - JDS Labs is in the register of refusals, so it has none and will have none. jds-labs.json survives because it is the one carrying the refusal and its quoted clause; jds.json held nothing but an id and a name. Keys carried over: none, it held nothing new. Found by a new guard in the verifier that refuses two brand files claiming one name - added the same day after I created a fourth such duplicate by accident, which is how these three came to light. They had passed every check since they were written: the mutant suite tests that a RECORD cites a brand that exists, and most brand files here are census entries with no records, so « cited by nobody » could never have been the guard.
